Siri AI is a major upgrade and highlight of iOS 27 and later. But only newer Apple devices support this overhauled Siri. Here's the full list of hardware that supports Siri AI on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Here are the Apple products that support Siri AI on iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and its accompanying updates include the long-awaited major Siri overhaul, called Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in specific regions). Here are all the Apple products that support Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models equipped with Apple Silicon (M1 chip and later models, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (requires pairing with an AI-capable iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later models
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later models
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All of the above products support Siri AI. However, some features of the Siri experience will perform better on specific hardware.

For example, the ability to fully customize Siri AI voice cadence and expressiveness is only available on certain hardware. Apple says:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI models are only available on newer products. Users with these models may experience faster performance when using Siri AI, or they may not.

Does Siri AI make you want to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Feel free to tell us in the comments section.
